upload.title: Upload your portrait photo
upload.subtitle: Take a photo against a plain wall or upload an existing picture.
upload.dragDrop: Drag & drop your photo here, or browse files
upload.supports: Supports JPG, PNG, WEBP, and HEIC (up to 25MB). Auto-rotates & scales smoothly.
upload.tipsTitle: Tips for a compliant passport photo:
upload.tip1: Look directly at camera with neutral expression
upload.tip2: Even lighting without dark shadows or reflections
upload.tip3: Plain wall background helps AI remove it cleanly
upload.tip4: Keep head straight and shoulders visible

preset.title: Select Country & Passport Standard
preset.subtitle: Standard 300 DPI passport, visa, and exam size specifications.

crop.title: Crop and Align Face
crop.subtitle: Center your face inside the guideline box so head height is 70-80%.

background.title: Background Removal & Replacement
background.subtitle: Remove background in one click, choose official colors, or touch up with the brush.

adjust.title: Photo Adjustments & Compression
adjust.subtitle: Enhance portrait clarity and compress to meet strict portal file size limits.

sheet.title: Print Sheet Maker
sheet.subtitle: Arrange photos onto standard paper sheets with exact millimeter precision.
sheet.maxFit: Maximum photos fitting on this sheet: {count}
sheet.printTip: Important Print Setting: Always print at 100% or 'Actual Size'. Never select 'Fit to Page' or 'Shrink to Printable Area'!
